==Purpose of template==
Add a [[One Power]] [[Strength in the One Power rankings|strength]] table entry sortable by the "number" type (doesn't prepend the |).

==How to use==
 <nowiki>{{SortableOPS|power}}</nowiki>

The "power" parameter is a simple integer from 1 to 78, where 1 is equivalent to ++1, 7 is equivalent to 1(+12), 19 is equivalent to 13(1) and 78 is equivalent to 72(6).

==Example==

<pre>{| class="article-table sortable" 
|+
! data-sort-type="number" |Power Index
! data-sort-type="number" |Power Notation
|-
|1
|{{SortableOPS|1}}
|-
|6
|{{SortableOPS|6}}
|-
|7
|{{SortableOPS|7}}
|-
|18
|{{SortableOPS|18}}
|-
|19
|{{SortableOPS|19}}
|-
|78
|{{SortableOPS|78}}
|-
|}</pre>
